description: r0b0tlab's SGLang runtime for NVIDIA's unmodified nvidia/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 (revision fc694b54, NVIDIA Open Model License plus Qwen terms) on one Spark, from r0b0tlab/qwen38-flash-next-nvidia-nvfp4-sm121-sglang v1.0.1 (1dc3c2f0, MIT). Runs upstream's published v1.0.1-sm121-nextn image (patched SGLang 0.5.19-era, digest-pinned) through its own profile compiler: native NVFP4 W4A4 experts on FlashInfer CUTLASS, FP8 block-scaled integrated MTP (NEXTN, 3 steps), BF16 KV, BF16 vision (image, multi-image, video), a file-backed PLE embedding offload (about 48 GiB prepared once into the platform cache, 4 GiB RSS budget) and full decode CUDA graphs, with 262,144 tokens of context in one shared KV pool. The profile option picks upstream's frozen profiles: production c2 (two requests share the 262K pool), c4, or the same c2 with ViT CUDA graphs off, which upstream ships for sustained mixed-shape vision traffic. Context and request limits are fixed by the profile and are not editable settings. Upstream claims (not measured here): 37.32 tok/s dedicated c1, NEXTN acceptance length 3.38, needle-in-a-haystack 9/9 to 258K, Q200 185/200, vision 11/11; weights load about 9 minutes; needs an otherwise idle Spark with at least 104 GiB host RAM available and does not sustain two consecutive full-window prefills. Upstream's own verdict is runtime and Q200 verified, not a physical Vonk acceptance. Physical Spark acceptance is pending.
title: Qwen3.8 Flash Next NVFP4 SGLang single Spark (r0b0tlab)
